summary: Cloud phone system for sales and support teams with call routing, SMS and CRM integrations.
access_note: Basic auth (api_id and api_token) is for Aircall customers on their own account; OAuth is only for approved Technology Partners and needs client_id/secret from Aircall.
blocker_note: No free API path: Basic auth keys require an Aircall customer account (paid plans; the pricing page lists full API access in the Professional tier). OAuth is only for approved Technology Partners.

notes: Aircall MCP FAQ states it does not offer its own MCP server; only community repos exist (themobilefirstco has about 2 stars, so usage is thin). Pricing page lists Full API access just before the Enterprise tier, i.e. Professional; exact plan floor not confirmed on a dedicated page.

review.reason: A customer can generate api_id/api_token themselves (Basic auth) without any partner step; only OAuth needs partner approval.
Per-user path is Basic auth on a paid Aircall account; partner program only affects OAuth/marketplace.
